title: finding(i18n): four more `dashboard.*` keys read as CONFIRMED dead by the reverse sweep — `addWidget`, `editLayout`, `saveLayout`, `resetLayout`
body:
Filed unassigned, out of scope for #7125 / PR #7573 (which retires `dashboard.noRows` and `dashboard.noDataAvailable` only). Recorded because the same namespace was measured on the way past, not because anything was fixed here.

## Measurement

`node scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs` on `2b343c226` (after #7125's deletion) reports the `dashboard` namespace as **4 confirmed, 1 needs-review**:

```
  dashboard (4 confirmed, 1 needs-review):
    [confirmed]     dashboard.addWidget
    [confirmed]     dashboard.editLayout
    [confirmed]     dashboard.resetLayout
    [confirmed]     dashboard.saveLayout
    [needs-review]  dashboard.removeWidget
```

`CONFIRMED` in that report means the AST pass sees no `t()`/`tt()` call site **and** the literal key string has no textual footprint anywhere else in the repo. Cross-checked by hand, by fully-qualified key, over `packages/` + `apps/`:

| key | occurrences outside the ten packs |
|---|---|
| `dashboard.addWidget` | 0 |
| `dashboard.editLayout` | 0 |
| `dashboard.saveLayout` | 0 |
| `dashboard.resetLayout` | 0 |

That is 40 pack entries (4 keys x 10 packs) with no reader this pass can see.

## The fifth one is probably a substring artifact, not a live key

`dashboard.removeWidget` is listed `needs-review` — the class that means "some other file contains the literal string". Its four occurrences are all `engine.inspector.dashboard.removeWidget`, a **different** key in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`'s module-local table, read by `DashboardDefaultInspector.tsx`. The dotted path `dashboard.removeWidget` happens to be a suffix of it. So the needs-review verdict here is substring-driven and does not attest to a call site — worth stating, because it is the same one-name-several-keys shape that #7125 and #7218 both turned on.

## What this finding does NOT claim

- ⛔ Not that these are safe to delete today. The reverse sweep is **report-only by design** (#4658) and is structurally capable of false positives — a key reached only through an indirect variable, or from `examples/`/`e2e/`, which its walk does not cover. Each key still needs the per-key confirmation #7125 got: fully-qualified sweep with a lit control, plus `check:i18n-keys` staying green across the deletion.
- ⛔ Not a claim about the other 138 CONFIRMED candidates the same report lists across 47 namespaces. Only this namespace was looked at.

## If it is taken

The deletion shape is settled by five precedents (#4145, #4392, #4730, #5504, #6310) and now a sixth in PR #7573: delete the row from all ten packs together (`all-locales-key-parity` is the gate that catches a pack left behind), add a negative pin test, and declare a `patch` changeset for `@object-ui/i18n`. ⚠️ Delete by fully-qualified key — `dashboard.addWidget` and friends are short names, and a bare-name sweep is exactly how a live key in another namespace goes with them.
